title: research: P104 B-form floor follow-up: RootFact/SpanFact proved (hand + Lean), Cases II/III without the census (no κ claim)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Follow-up to #6188 (research/p104-bform-nine-term-floor, merged). Adds only `research/p104-bform-hand-closures/`. No κ claim, no supplier word.

- **RootFact** (every `x ≠ 0` is non-orthogonal to ≥ 49 ports of P104) and **SpanFact** (the corrected span lemma of #6188, with its 104 port exceptions): hand proofs (`hand/HAND-ROOTFACT.md`, `hand/HAND-SPANFACT.md`) and Lean theorems `BForm.E8h.rootFact_h`, `BForm.E8h.spanFact_h`. Proof shape: dominant chamber (simple reflections), parabolic subsystems of E8 (only E7 exceeds 42 lines), labels = E8 mod 2, Gauss sums.
- `BForm.E8h.bform_floor_P104_h`: #6188's `BForm.bform_floor` with both hypotheses discharged. Remaining hypotheses: `Capacity`, `BicliqueFact`, `CensusFact`. `#print axioms`: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; no `sorry`.
- **Cases II/III (any `D`, singular included) without the census**: label caps `f(1..8) = 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 20, 36, 60` and the pair form of the M_J bound give "at most one big term with `d ≥ 3`, and it has `d ≤ 4`", so cost ≤ 55 would need ≥ 6 pairwise compatible label planes. **Lemma P** (computed): 15240 compatible plane pairs, each plane in at most 2, no 4 pairwise compatible. So Σσ' ≤ 5 < 8. This replaces cnt9b/cnt9c/cnt9z, `lb`, survivor and port classes and the clique/support filters for these cases.

Status: PROOF (hand + Lean) for RootFact/SpanFact; PROOF from a CHECKED finite lemma for Cases II/III. Remaining obligations: a hand proof of Lemma P (the root-normal case has zero slack: pairs with 3–4 uncovered ports exist and are excluded only by the non-orthogonality of the exceptions; `evidence/rootcase.txt`), and a Lean formalisation of §4 (would discharge `CensusFact`).

## Task and overlap

Base `a5bff3bf1`. Card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, scope **refined** (same route as #6188; answers its open question 2). Inputs pinned in `SOURCES.json`: research/nine-term-outside-colspace (E8 lines, frames), research/p104-bform-nine-term-floor (`checks/lbz.py` flat list; Lean files copied byte-identically, checked by the verifier).
Overlap: #6198 (e8-odd-characteristic-spans) proves other E8 span facts (S1, S2, S3′, W2 of #2819) over odd characteristic; no overlap with RootFact/SpanFact. Nothing on main proves these facts or replaces the census.

## Validation

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-bform-hand-closures --check-only   # PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-bform-hand-closures             # bounded verifier, ~5 min, numpy only
FULL=1 python3 -B research/p104-bform-hand-closures/verify.py                                   # + Lemma P re-run, ~12 min more
cd research/p104-bform-hand-closures/lean && lake exe cache get && lake build && lake env lean BForm/E8h/AxiomsH.lean
```

- Bounded verifier: finite facts of both hand proofs; Lean data regenerated from `data/` equals the shipped files; #6188 Lean files byte-identical; no `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`; `f(1..6)` recomputed; logs authenticated against `RESULT.json` (Lemma P local and Kaggle runs agree). Controls rejected: a log with a family of 4 compatible planes, a Lean log with an extra axiom, a corrupted hash.
- Kaggle `matare/p104-bform-hand-pkg`: Lean build of all 11 targets OK (peak 10.8 GB, ~35 min on 4 cores incl. Mathlib cache), axioms as above, Lemma P re-run 15240 / max family 3, hand checks ALL PASS (`evidence/kaggle/`).
- Kaggle `matare/p104-bform-hand-verify`: `FULL=1` verifier without networkx: `PASS_P104_BFORM_HAND_CLOSURES`, Lemma P re-run with `checks/labels.py` equals the logs (`VERIFY FULL PASS`, 1136 s).
- Not run: `--check-source-history` (shallow clone; `check_research_commit.py` byte check PASS).

## Credit

Prepared by Matarener with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code; Kaggle for the runs. Builds on #6188 and research/nine-term-outside-colspace (DreamingOfClouds). Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Hand proof of Lemma P, or of "compatible planes have disjoint live sets" (already enough: gives `k ≤ 5`). Blocker: zero margin in the root case.
2. Formalise PROOF.md §4 in Lean to discharge `CensusFact`.
3. Classify rank-9 realisations of the P104 pattern (unchanged from #6188).
